terra.problem: “No crowd” and “just him” imply Hezekiah was alone, which the text does not say.
“No shouting” claims a detail about how Hezekiah prayed that the text does not give.
The text does not say Hezekiah received the first message three days earlier. The third day is counted from the new message.
It says Hezekiah is going up to worship, but the passage does not state his purpose.
“He's called David” followed by “He's called ... the God of your father David” confuses David with the LORD.
“One ingredient” asserts that the poultice contained only figs. The text names figs but does not give a complete ingredient list.
“Nobody in the text is afraid of the shadow” claims knowledge of others' feelings that the passage does not give.
The closing line makes a joke about how Jehoshaphat's name is said.
